end.summary:
Recognised some equal-part shapes and named 1/4 and 2/4 in examples.
Practised identifying halves, thirds and quarters; this was not steady yet and needs checking next time.
Mixed up parts taken with parts left and the whole when naming a fraction.
Needed further practice noticing that fractional parts must be equal; this mix-up was still present at the end.
end.parentNote: Asha practised equal shares and naming halves, thirds and quarters with Nisha. Nisha identified some examples, including 1/4 and 2/4, but sometimes compared pieces taken with pieces left, and sometimes treated unequal pieces as thirds; these mix-ups were not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, share a paper or fruit into equal pieces and ask, “How many equal parts make the whole?” before naming the fraction.
